plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Farm Direct uses your location to show farms, stalls and markets near you. It is only used while the app is open.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Farm Direct uses your location to show farms, stalls and markets near you.

plugins.photosPermission: Farm Direct needs your photos so you can add pictures of your farm, stall or produce to your listing.
plugins.cameraPermission: Farm Direct uses your camera so you can take pictures of your farm, stall or produce for your listing.
